H6483.name: Happizzez
H6483.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6483.brief: The head of the 18th priestly division.
H6483.short: Happizzez was the head of the 18th division of priests during the time of David's organization of the priesthood.

H6474.name: Paarai
H6474.desc: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
H6474.short: Paarai the Arbite was one of David's mighty men, known for his military prowess.

H6420.name: Palal
H6420.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6420.brief: Son of Uzai, repaired Jerusalem's wall
H6420.short: Palal, son of Uzai, repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall near the Parbar during Nehemiah's time.

H6406H.name: Palti
H6406H.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H6406H.short: Palti (Paltiel), son of Laish, was Michal's husband from Gallim before she was taken back by David.

H6406G.name: Palti
H6406G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H6406G.brief: Son of Raphu, spy from Benjamin
H6406G.short: Palti, son of Raphu, was the spy from the tribe of Benjamin sent to explore Canaan.

H6409G.name: Paltiel
H6409G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H6409G.brief: Leader from Issachar, helped divide Canaan
H6409G.short: Paltiel, son of Azzan, was the leader from the tribe of Issachar who helped divide the land of Canaan.

H6457.name: Pasach
H6457.brief: Son of Japhlet from the tribe of Asher
H6457.short: Pasach, a son of Japhlet, who was a descendant of Asher.

H6454G.name: Paseah
H6454G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6454G.brief: Son of Eshton from the tribe of Judah
H6454G.short: Paseah, a son of Eshton, who was from the tribe of Judah.

H6454H.name: Paseah
H6454H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6454H.brief: Ancestor of temple servants who returned from exile
H6454H.short: Paseah, whose descendants were among the temple servants that returned from Babylonian exile.

H6454I.name: Paseah
H6454I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6454I.brief: Father of Joiada, who repaired the Old Gate
H6454I.short: Paseah the father of Joiada (or 'Jehoiada'), who helped repair the Old Gate of Jerusalem.

H6492.name: Pekah
H6492.desc: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6492.brief: King of Israel who reigned for 20 years
H6492.short: Pekah, son of Remaliah, king of Israel who reigned for 20 years.

H6494.name: Pekahiah
H6494.desc: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6494.brief: King of Israel who reigned for 2 years
H6494.short: Pekahiah, son of Menahem, king of Israel who reigned for 2 years before being assassinated.

H6411B.name: Pelaiah
H6411B.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6411B.short: Pelaiah, a descendant of King David, mentioned in the genealogy of 1Chronicles 3.

H6411A.name: Pelaiah
H6411A.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6411A.brief: Levite who helped explain the Law and signed the covenant
H6411A.short: Pelaiah, a Levite who helped explain the Law to the people and signed Nehemiah's covenant.

H6421.name: Pelaliah
H6421.desc: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
H6421.brief: Priest in Jerusalem during Nehemiah's time
H6421.short: Pelaliah, a priest who lived in Jerusalem during Nehemiah's time.

H6410G.name: Pelatiah
H6410G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6410G.short: Pelatiah, a descendant of King Solomon mentioned in the genealogy of 1Chronicles 3.

H6410H.name: Pelatiah
H6410H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6410H.brief: Simeonite leader who attacked the Amalekites
H6410H.short: Pelatiah, a Simeonite leader who joined in an attack against the Amalekites.

H6410J.name: Pelatiah
H6410J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6410J.brief: Prince of Israel whom Ezekiel saw in a vision
H6410J.short: Pelatiah, a prince of Israel whom Ezekiel saw in a vision, and who died as Ezekiel prophesied.

H6410I.name: Pelatiah
H6410I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6410I.short: Pelatiah, a priest who signed the covenant during Nehemiah's time.

H6404H.name: Pelet
H6404H.desc: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6404H.brief: Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag
H6404H.short: Pelet, a Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag, along with his brother Berachah.

H6404G.name: Pelet
H6404G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6404G.brief: Son of Jahdai, descendant of Judah
H6404G.short: Pelet, a son of Jahdai, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah in 1Chronicles 2.

H6431H.name: Peleth
H6431H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6431H.brief: Son of Jonathan, descendant of Jerahmeel
H6431H.short: Peleth, a son of Jonathan and descendant of Jerahmeel, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

H6431G.name: Peleth
H6431G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H6431G.brief: Reubenite, father of On who rebelled against Moses
H6431G.short: Peleth, a Reubenite; father of On who joined Korah's rebellion against Moses.

H6432.name: Pelethites
H6432.brief: Elite military unit loyal to King David
H6432.short: The Pelethites, along with the Cherethites, were an elite military unit loyal to King David.

H6444.name: Peninnah
H6444.desc: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
H6444.short: Peninnah, one of Elkanah's two wives and the rival of Hannah, Samuel's mother.

H6439H.name: Penuel
H6439H.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H6439H.brief: Son of Hur, descendant of Judah
H6439H.short: Penuel, a son of Hur and descendant of Judah, mentioned in the genealogy of 1Chronicles 4.

H6439I.name: Penuel
H6439I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6439I.brief: Son of Shashak, descendant of Benjamin
H6439I.short: Penuel, a son of Shashak and descendant of Benjamin, mentioned in the genealogy of 1Chronicles 8.

H6469.name: Peullethai
H6469.desc: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
H6469.brief: Son of Obed-Edom, a temple gatekeeper
H6469.short: Peullethai, the eighth son of Obed-Edom, a gatekeeper in the temple during the time of David.

H6430H.name: Philistine
H6430H.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H6430H.brief: Descendants of Mizraim, son of Ham
H6430H.short: The Philistines, a people group descended from Mizraim, the son of Ham, according to the Table of Nations in Genesis and 1 Chronicles.

H6401.name: Pilha
H6401.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6401.short: Pilha, one of the leaders of the people who signed the covenant during Nehemiah's time.

H6408.name: Piltai
H6408.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6408.short: Piltai, the head of the priestly family of Moadiah during the time of Joiakim, the high priest.

H6462.name: Pispa
H6462.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6462.short: Pispa, a descendant of Asher, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher in 1 Chronicles.

H6438G.name: Corner Gate
H6438G.short: The Corner Gate was a fortified gate in Jerusalem's wall, mentioned in connection with repairs and measurements of the city.

H6464.name: Pau
H6464.short: Pau, also known as Pai, was a city in Edom mentioned in the genealogy of Edomite kings.

H6439G.name: Peniel
H6439G.brief: A place where Jacob wrestled with God
H6439G.short: Peniel, also called Penuel, was the place where Jacob wrestled with God and had his name changed to Israel.

H6465.name: Peor
H6465.brief: A mountain in Moab associated with idolatry
H6465.short: Peor was a mountain in Moab where Balak brought Balaam to curse Israel, and where the Israelites later engaged in idolatry and immorality with the Moabites.

H6429.name: Philistia
H6429.brief: An ancient people and region in Canaan
H6429.short: The Philistines were a powerful people who inhabited the coastal plain of Canaan and were often in conflict with the Israelites during the period of the judges and early monarchy.

H6449.name: Pisgah
H6449.brief: A mountain range in Moab, east of the Jordan
H6449.short: Pisgah, or the slopes of Pisgah, was a mountain range in Moab where Moses viewed the Promised Land before his death.

H6453.name: Passover
H6453.brief: An annual Jewish feast commemorating the Exodus
H6453.short: The Passover is an annual Jewish feast that commemorates the deliverance of the Israelites from slavery in Egypt, as described in Exodus 12, and is celebrated with specific rituals and offerings as prescribed in the Old Testament and observed in the New Testament.
